seo_title: SC: National Book Trust Is a 'State' Under Article 12
title: Supreme Court: National Book Trust Is a 'State' Under Article 12, Upholds Delhi HC Full Bench
case_name: The Chairman, National Book Trust, India and Another v. A.R. Abdul Gaffar and Others
citation: Civil Appeal No. 14369 of 2015; 2026 INSC 1202, decided 6 November 2026
card_summary: The Supreme Court has held that the National Book Trust is a 'State' under Article 12, upholding the Delhi High Court's 2012 Full Bench ruling and dismissing the Trust's appeal. The bench looked at the cumulative effect of government control over the Trust, not any one factor, and held that this does not make the Trust a government department or its staff government servants.
card_tip: Autonomous societies under heavy government control can still be 'State' for writ jurisdiction, even though that status alone does not make their staff government servants.
